17700.meaning2: speaking with absolute certainty; having absolute views

17710.grammar: adj, fem nom & acc pl of eka

kadā nu'haṃ pabbatakandarāsu, ekākiyo addutiyo vihassaṃ, aniccato sabbabhavaṃ vipassaṃ, taṃ me idaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

17715.commentary: (MNa) ek'āgārikan'ti paṇṇāsamattā'pi saṭṭhimattā'pi parivāretvā jīvaggāhaṃ gahetvā āharāpenti. (ANa) ek'āgārikan'ti ekam'eva gehaṃ parivāretvā vilumpanaṃ.

examples.text: tīhi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhim'pi chindati, nillopam'pi harati, ek'āgārikam'pi karoti, paripanthe'pi tiṭṭhati. katamehi tīhi?
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu sandhim'pi chindanti, nillopam'pi haranti, ek'āgārikam'pi karonti, paripanthe'pi tiṭṭhanti, paradāram'pi gacchanti.

17716.meaning1: ascetic who subsists on food from only one house
17716.commentary: (DNa) ek'āgāriko'ti yo ekasmiṃ'y'eva gehe bhikkhaṃ labhitvā nivattati

examples.text: te ek'āgārikā vā honti ek'ālopikā, dv'āgārikā vā honti dv'ālopikā… satt'āgārikā vā honti satt'ālopikā. ekissā'pi dattiyā yāpenti, dvīhi'pi dattīhi yāpenti… sattahi'pi dattīhi yāpenti.
kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, atthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ek'ācariyo'pi, ek'ācariyapācariyo'pi, yāva sattamā ācariyamahayugā'pi, yo evam'āha, aham'etaṃ jānāmi, aham'etaṃ passāmi. idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti?

17718.meaning2: one teacher's teacher; a single former teacher

examples.text: kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, atthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ek'ācariyo'pi, ek'ācariyapācariyo'pi, yāva sattamā ācariyamahayugā'pi, yo evam'āha, aham'etaṃ jānāmi, aham'etaṃ passāmi. idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti?
mettāya, bhikkhave, cetovimuttiyā āsevitāya bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya ekādasa-ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
ekādasahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātiṃ kātuṃ. katamehi ekādasahi?
taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ hotī'ti ekādase aruṇ'uggamane nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
akālacīvaraṃ nāma anatthate kathine ekādasamāse uppannaṃ, atthate kathine sattamāse uppannaṃ, kāle'pi ādissa dinnaṃ, etaṃ akālacīvaraṃ nāma.

17725.meaning1: having eleven doors; with eleven entrances

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, purisassa agāraṃ ekādasadvāraṃ, so tasmiṃ agāre āditte ekam'ekena'pi dvārena sakkuṇeyya attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ. evam'eva kho ahaṃ, bhante, imesaṃ ekādasannaṃ amatadvārānaṃ ekam'ekena'pi amatadvārena sakkuṇissāmi attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ.
iti h'etaṃ vijānāma, ekādasamo so parābhavo, dvādasamaṃ bhagavā brūhi, kiṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

17733.meaning1: one observation; one contemplation; one insight

examples.text: idaṃ dukkhaṃ, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo'ti ayam'ek'ānupassanā. ayaṃ dukkhanirodho, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti, ayaṃ dutiy'ānupassanā.
yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ upadhipaccayā'ti, ayam'ek'ānupassanā. upadhīnaṃ tv'eva asesavirāganirodhā n'atthi dukkhassa sambhavo'ti, ayaṃ dutiy'ānupassanā.

17734.meaning1: with one theme; on one topic

examples.text: buddhānaṃ pana saṅkhalikāni viya ek'ābaddhāni hutvā ṭhitāni, tasmā pacchato apalokanakāle na sakkā hoti gīvaṃ parivattetuṃ.

17736.meaning1: (gram) mentioning together; taking together; one expression

examples.text: 409, 441. sabbesam'ek'ābhidhāne paro puriso.

sabbesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ paṭhamamajjhim'uttamapurisānaṃ ek'ābhidhāne paro puriso gahetabbo. so ca paṭhati, tvañ'ca paṭhasi, tumhe paṭhatha. so ca pacati, tvañ'ca pacasi. tumhe pacatha. evaṃ sesāsu vibhattīsu paro puriso yojetabbo.

17737.grammar: card, fem instr sg of eka

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā udāyī yena sā kumārikā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā tassā kumārikāya saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappesi kālayuttaṃ samullapanto kālayuttaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇanto
yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappeyya

17738.commentary: (MNa) ek'āyanena maggenā'ti ekapathen'eva maggena, anukkamaniyena ubhosu passesu nirantara-kaṇṭaka-rukkhagahanena.

examples.text: ek'āyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā

atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito ek'āyanena maggena tam'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ paṇidhāya. tam'enaṃ cakkhumā puriso disvā evaṃ vadeyya, tath'āyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso paṭipanno tathā ca iriyati tañ'ca maggaṃ samārūḷho, yathā imaṃ'y'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ āgamissatī'ti.
tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā itthisahassānaṃ ekā'y'eva sā itthī hoti yā maṃ tena samayena paccupaṭṭhāti, khattiyānī vā velāmikā vā.
n'el'aṅgo setapacchādo, ek'āro vattatī ratho, anīghaṃ passa āyantaṃ, chinnasotaṃ abandhanan'ti.

17741.meaning1: (gram) letter e; 7th letter of the alphabet; gutturo-palatal vowel

examples.text: sare pare antassa ekārassa kvaci yo ādeso hoti.
te o e'icc'ete āva āy'ādese pāpuṇanti kārite. lāveti, nāyeti. yogavibhāgena aññasmim'pi ekārassa āy'ādeso hoti. gāyati, gāyanti.

17742.meaning1: (gram) vuddhi form of the letters i and ī

examples.text: ekārassa dhātv'antassa sare pare ay'ādeso hoti. nayati, jayati.

17743.commentary: (NIDD1a) ek'ārakkho'ti sati-ārakkhena eko uttamo ārakkho assā'ti ek'ārakkho.

examples.text: kathañ'c'āvuso, bhikkhu ek'ārakkho hoti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu sat'ārakkhena cetasā samannāgato hoti.

17745.meaning1: delight in solitude; pleasure in one's own company
17745.commentary: (DNa) apanujjā'ti tesaṃ majjhe'pi phalasamāpattiyā viharanto cittena apanujja, apanujj'eva ek'ārāmataṃ anuyutto viharatī'ti attho.

examples.text: te bhagavā apanujja ek'ārāmataṃ anuyutto viharati. evaṃ ek'ārāmataṃ anuyuttaṃ iminā'p'aṅgena samannāgataṃ satthāraṃ n'eva atīt'aṃse samanupassāma, na pan'eta'r'ahi, aññatra tena bhagavatā.

17746.meaning1: ascetic who subsists on only one mouthful of food
17746.commentary: (DNa) ek'ālopiko'ti yo eken'eva ālopena yāpeti. dv'āgārik'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: te ek'āgārikā vā honti ek'ālopikā, dv'āgārikā vā honti dv'ālopikā… satt'āgārikā vā honti satt'ālopikā. ekissā'pi dattiyā yāpenti, dvīhi'pi dattīhi yāpenti… sattahi'pi dattīhi yāpenti.
ek'āsanaṃ ekaseyyaṃ, eko caram'atandito, eko damayam'attānaṃ, van'ante ramito siyā.
ek'āsanassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ekattaṃ monam'akkhātaṃ, eko ce abhiramissasi, atha bhāhisi dasadisā.
subhāsitassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ek'āsanassa ca raho, cittavūpasamassa cā'ti.
gilānasamayo nāma na sakkoti ek'āsane nisinno yāva'd'atthaṃ bhuñjituṃ, gilānasamayo'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ.

etha, tumhe'pi, bhikkhave, ek'āsanabhojanaṃ bhuñjatha. ek'āsanabhojanaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tumhe'pi bhuñjamānā app'ābādhatañ'ca sañjānissatha app'ātaṅkatañ'ca lah'uṭṭhānañ'ca balañ'ca phāsuvihārañ'cā'ti.

te kul'itthīhi kuladhītāhi kulakumārīhi kulasuṇhāhi kuladāsīhi saddhiṃ ekabhājane'pi bhuñjanti, ekathālake'pi pivanti, ek'āsane'pi nisīdanti, ekamañce'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ekapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti

17751.meaning1: eating in one sitting; (comm) eating up to seven times between dawn and noon
17751.commentary: (MNa) ek'āsanabhojanan'ti ekaṃ purebhattabhojanaṃ. sūriy'uggamanato hi yāva majjh'anhikā sattakkhattuṃ bhuttabhojanam'pi idha ek'āsanabhojanan't'eva adhippetaṃ.

examples.text: ahaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ek'āsanabhojanaṃ bhuñjāmi. ek'āsanabhojanaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, bhuñjamāno app'ābādhatañ'ca sañjānāmi app'ātaṅkatañ'ca lah'uṭṭhānañ'ca balañ'ca phāsuvihārañ'ca.

etha, tumhe'pi, bhikkhave, ek'āsanabhojanaṃ bhuñjatha. ek'āsanabhojanaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tumhe'pi bhuñjamānā app'ābādhatañ'ca sañjānissatha app'ātaṅkatañ'ca lah'uṭṭhānañ'ca balañ'ca phāsuvihārañ'cā'ti.

17753.meaning2: practice of eating at one sitting

examples.text: ek'āsanik'aṅgaṃ pattapiṇḍik'aṅgaṃ khalupacchābhattik'aṅgaṃ āraññik'aṅgaṃ rukkhamūlik'aṅgaṃ abbhokāsik'aṅgaṃ sosānik'aṅgaṃ

dasavassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu ek'idaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti, ek'idaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā.

examples.text: manussā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā cetiyarukkhaṃ chedāpessanti gāmapūjitaṃ nigamapūjitaṃ nagarapūjitaṃ janapadapūjitaṃ raṭṭhapūjitaṃ! ek'indriyaṃ samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jīvaṃ viheṭhentī'ti.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno mettaṃ vacīkammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu āvi c'eva raho ca. ayam'pi dhammo sāraṇīyo piyakaraṇo garukaraṇo saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekibhāvāya saṃvattati.

17769.grammar: card, fem instr sg of eka

examples.text: te ek'āgārikā vā honti ek'ālopikā, dv'āgārikā vā honti dv'ālopikā… satt'āgārikā vā honti satt'ālopikā. ekissā'pi dattiyā yāpenti, dvīhi'pi dattīhi yāpenti… sattahi'pi dattīhi yāpenti.
ekissā'pi, bhante, sattiyā haññamāno tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha, ko pana vādo tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno'ti!
addhā ayam'āyasmā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passatī'ti. ayam'pi dhammo piyattāya garuttāya bhāvanāya sāmaññāya ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu āvi c'eva raho ca, ayam'pi dhammo sāraṇīyo piyakaraṇo garukaraṇo saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.

ek'ūnatiṃso vayasā subhadda, yaṃ pabbajiṃ kiṃkusal'ānuesī, vassāni paññāsa samādhikāni, yato ahaṃ pabbajito subhadda.
pañcadasa divasāni paṭicchannāya pakkhapaṭicchannan'ti vatvā yojanā kātabbā. tato yāva ek'ūnatiṃsatimo divaso, tāva atirekapakkhapaṭicchannan'ti.

ek'ūnavīse uppanne mūlacīvare paccāsācīvaraṃ uppajjati, das'āhā kāretabbaṃ.
lokavādapaṭisaṃyuttāya diṭṭhiyā aṭṭhahi ākārehi abhiniveso hoti. bhavadiṭṭhiyā ek'ūnavīsatiyā ākārena abhiniveso hoti. vibhavadiṭṭhiyā ekena ākārena abhiniveso hoti.

tattha yo dvādasamāse mātukucchismiṃ vasitvā mahāpavāraṇāya jāto, so tato paṭṭhāya yāva ek'ūnavīsatime vasse mahāpavāraṇā, taṃ atikkamitvā pāṭipade upasampādetabbo. eten'upāyena hāyanavaḍḍhanaṃ veditabbaṃ.
